name: Graceful Exit
text: Whenever you lose a trick you played a face card to, gain +20 contract value.

signature.trigger: you lose a trick with a face card

archetypes: Nil Champion, Blind Bidder, Discard Dominance
decision: When to dump a face card under a higher card.
opponent: Visible on trigger; no effect on opponents' cards.
aiNote: Discard face cards on tricks already won by others.
rationale: About 20 expected points per round. A seat loses with one or two of its face cards, and each loss is a card spent rather than a trick won, so the reward is sized to feel worth the sacrifice.
